role: CI gate: both the Emuqu and EmuquWatch Watch App targets ship Localizable.xcstrings in Resources, and every localized literal in code resolves to a catalogue key.
toplevel: cd to repo root. SCAN_DIRS Emuqu/Sources and watch app (missing -> 2); catalogue missing -> 2. Python 1 (pbxproj): for each target finds its Resources phase and requires 'Localizable.xcstrings in Resources' (target missing -> 2, missing resource -> 1). Python 2: parse catalogue (error -> 2, empty -> 2); imports the shared extractor scripts/lib/localization_extract.py (same one as the orphan gate: String/AttributedString(localized:, LocalizedStringKey(, NSLocalizedString(, SwiftUI Text/Button/Label/Toggle/TextField/Picker/Section and modifiers, multi-line literals, verbatim: skipped, first-argument literals); literals without 2+ letters skipped; each literal's candidate keys must exist or match key_pattern (%@ widened); unresolved -> exit 1.
